caption: The same two processes both ways: without preemption P1 runs 0–8 ms and P2 follows; with preemption P2 cuts in at 1 ms and P1 resumes at 5 ms. P2's wait falls from 7 ms to 0.

spec.aria: Two timelines for the same two processes: without preemption P1 runs to 8 ms before P2 starts, with preemption P2 cuts in at 1 ms and P1 resumes at 5 ms.
